source: capsule-engine#265: the admission loader's refusals. Each case applies its ops (set or delete at a path of keys and indexes) to the parsed base pack and re-encodes it as JCS, or gives its bytes outright; Load must refuse it with an error containing want. Go (go/admission) and Rust (rust/capsule-engine admission) decide every case.

cases.want: a card row may not decide NO
a vouch row may not decide NO
a judged row's on_fail must be {cap: <tier>}
a judged row's on_fail must be {cap: <tier>}
cap T2 must be a tier below from T2

cases.case: a judged row in a pack without LIMIT
cases.want: a judged row caps a tier, so LIMIT must be in outcomes

cases.case: a missing input defaults to GO
an ask on a NO row
cases.want: only a LIMIT row may carry an ask

cases.case: a predicate under the wrong source

cases.want: null is not a pack value

cases.case: a ceiling in a unit accept does not name
cases.want: max_decade.Sat is not a band unit in accept

cases.case: a ceiling that falls across a skipped tier
cases.want: max_decade.sat 3 does not rise above the tier below (4)
null is not a pack value
band unit EUR is named by no tier

cases.case: an outcome the pack does not yield
a version that is not the id's

cases.want: null is not a pack value
null is not a pack value
null is not a pack value
trust_roots.judges: a name must not be empty

cases.case: a ladder that earns from no subject
a ladder step out of range
a ladder dispute rate out of range

cases.want: a card row may not decide NO

cases.case: a rail pin with a short digest
cases.want: digest must be 64 lowercase hex digits

cases.case: a rail pin with an uppercase digest
cases.want: digest must be 64 lowercase hex digits

cases.case: a rail pin with no id
a rail pin with another key

cases.want: a card row may not decide NO
